basis: GPI-anchor glycosylation disorder with severe neurodevelopmental disease; frequent strabismus and minor digital dysmorphism do not establish additional organ injury.

decisions.ocular: none: strabismus 30-79% and nystagmus 80-99% are ocular motor findings; intrinsic eye damage is unproven and amblyopia is 5-29%.
decisions.musculoskeletal: none: digital/foot dysmorphism occurs in 30-79%, without demonstrated functional injury; central hypotonia does not establish muscle disease.

basis: Central ventilatory/autonomic control failure; respiratory failure in 2/2 reflects impaired respiratory drive, without demonstrated intrinsic lung or airway disease.

decisions.pulmonary: none: hypoventilation and respiratory failure (2/2) arise from central drive failure; direct lung or airway disease is not demonstrated.

basis: HSV-2 herpes labialis affects lip vermilion and adjacent skin; intraoral mucosal disease is not specified.

decisions.gastrointestinal: none: herpes labialis localizes to external lip/vermilion; intraoral mucosal infection is not established.
decisions.dermatologic: primary: characteristic vesicular and ulcerative HSV lesions affect the lip vermilion and adjacent skin.

basis: Motor/autonomic neuropathy with defining esophageal achalasia; denervation muscle atrophy and joint stiffness occur in 80-99%. Sweating and acrocyanosis do not establish skin injury.

decisions.gastrointestinal: primary: esophageal achalasia is an explicit defining component, with persistent organ dysfunction in 80-99%.
decisions.musculoskeletal: involved: skeletal muscle atrophy and joint stiffness occur in 80-99%, documenting structural locomotor injury beyond weakness alone.

basis: GPI-anchor remodeling disorder with neurodevelopmental impairment; retinal dystrophy 2/2 and pulmonic stenosis 1/2. Enamel hypoplasia 1/1 omitted at cap; denominators are small.

decisions.gastrointestinal: none at cap: enamel hypoplasia 1/1 supports dental involvement, but retinal dystrophy and pulmonic stenosis take priority for severity.
decisions.metabolic_endocrine: primary: PGAP1 deficiency is an inborn GPI-anchor remodeling disorder, establishing a metabolic mechanism beyond the gene name alone.

basis: Coxiella infection commonly causes granulomatous hepatic inflammation; hepatocellular injury is supported by transaminase elevation in 30-79%. Pneumonia is 5-29%.

decisions.hepatic: involved: granulomatous hepatic inflammation is a usual disease manifestation; transaminase elevation in 30-79% supports common hepatocellular injury.

basis: Lipid disorder defined by corneal opacification; renal dysfunction and hemolytic anemia each 30-79%. Visual impairment is 5-29%; atherosclerosis is a separate disease.

decisions.ocular: primary: diffuse corneal opacification is a defining structural corneal lesion across LCAT deficiency subtypes; overt visual impairment is only 5-29%.

basis: Defining skeletal/CNS malformations; renal agenesis/hypoplasia 80-99%, PDA 30-79%. Laryngomalacia 30-79% omitted at cap; eyelid/ear anomalies lack demonstrated functional injury.

decisions.cardiovascular: involved: patent ductus arteriosus occurs in 30-79%; congenital cardiovascular shunting takes priority over laryngomalacia at the four-organ cap.
decisions.ocular: none: blepharophimosis is frequent (80-99%), but associated visual impairment or other functional eye damage is not established.

basis: Sensorimotor neuropathy; hand/foot deformities 2/4 and ovarian endocrine failure 2/5 support involvement. Strabismus 4/13 alone does not establish intrinsic eye injury.

decisions.ocular: none: strabismus 4/13 (~31%) does not establish intrinsic eye injury or visual loss; ophthalmoplegia is reported in only 1/4.

basis: Clonal plasma-cell disorder causes nonamyloid immunoglobulin deposition; renal deposition with dysfunction occurs in >90%. Significant cardiac or hepatic damage is less common.

decisions.renal: involved: renal deposition and dysfunction occur in >90%, downstream of the clonal plasma-cell disorder; this umbrella is not restricted to renal deposits.
